IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[FACT_AtencionMongo]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FACT_AtencionMongo]
	(
	 [ID_FACT_MONGO] int,
	 [ID_ATENCION_OLTP] bigint,
	 [IdDIMTIEMPO] int,
	 [ID_DIMPACIENTE] int,
	 [ID_DIMMEDICO] int,
	 [ID_DIMPATOLOGIA] int,
	 [ASISTIO_VAL] bit,
	 [DURACION_CONSULTA_MINUTOS] int,
	 [TIEMPO_ESPERA_REAL_MINUTOS] int,
	 [RECETO_MEDICAMENTO_FLAG] bit,
	 [SOLICITO_EXAMEN_FLAG] bit
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO
